source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 19ης Ιουνίου — «Όσιος Ζήνων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 19 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. He is none of the corpus's other men of the name — `zeno-of-diospolis`, `zeno-of-gaza`, `zeno-of-ikalto`, `zeno-of-nicomedia`, `zeno-the-courier`, `zeno-the-faster-of-kiev`, the three companions of Eudoxius, Peleus and Zoilus, or the martyrs of 22 June, 22 August and 3 September: this Zeno is the disciple of the great elder Silvanus who drove out demons and died at sixty-two. Which Silvanus the page means it does not say, and no folder is asserted for him. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence on the life page.
